## Related Issue

For **new features**, refactors, performance work, and other behavior changes, link an issue:

```
Closes #123
```

The linked issue must be labeled `ready` or `in progress` before the contribution check passes. (`approved` means it will be done later — not open for contributors yet.)

**Bug fixes** and **documentation updates** do not need a Ready issue. Linking one with `Closes #N` is still helpful when an issue already exists.

---

## Description

Explain what this PR changes and why.

---

## Type of Change

Check one. The contribution bot reads these exact checkboxes.

**Fast lane** (no Ready issue required):

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation update

**Needs a Ready issue** (`Closes #123` on an issue labeled `ready` or `in progress`):

- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / code cleanup
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Other (please describe)

---

## Test Plan

How did you verify this change?

- [ ] Tested locally
- [ ] Added or updated tests (if applicable)
- [ ] Checked related pages / flows for regressions

---

## Checklist

- [ ] My changes follow the existing project structure and coding standards
- [ ] Documentation has been updated if necessary
- [ ] For feature / refactor / performance / other: I linked an issue with `Closes #N`

## Screenshots (if applicable)

If this PR includes UI changes, include screenshots or GIFs.
